notes: Text rule: HERE uses its own single-letter form (the 'h' + triangle) as favicon and app icon, so it replaces the 4-letter wordmark. DECISION: the h's #092732 is a dark teal that vanishes on the dark tile; HERE publishes no dark 'h', and its dark logo (logo-white.svg) makes the same change for the wordmark (dark teal -> white, aqua kept) but its letters are one merged path, so its h can't be cut out. So the dark file recolours the h white (colour rule 2c). Alternative if Dhruv prefers the wordmark: HERE_logo_32px.svg (light) + HERE's own logo-white.svg (dark), both in downloads/here/c2src1/.
